segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so Northstar Foods is at 42 seats, annual, $31,920 before the onboarding line. They want June 17 as the go-live, which is fine if we can get the order form out today.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Is procurement okay with the net 30? Last note I saw had them asking for 45.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They backed off 45. The controller just wants the invoice to show the Chicago office as bill-to and their PO, 88419, on page one.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Anything weird in the CRM or is it just quote cleanup?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: The quote's clean. The CRM still has the total in gray because the deal desk cell is blank, so I bumped that email at 11:10 with the final seat count.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. And the contract, are we using our standard services addendum?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, standard. Customer redlines are gone. The tracker just has legal's box not blue yet, and I put the PDF back in their channel with the June 17 date in the filename.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Nice. If that lands, I can help package the order form and SOW. Onboarding is still 12 hours, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, 12 hours at $185, so $2,220. Billing profile is still sitting in draft, though, so I added the PO and bill-to note on the ticket for them this morning.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay, so once those fields turn over, send it to Ava at Northstar?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah. Ava and their controller, Marcus. They said they'll sign same day if it arrives before 3 p.m. Central.
